name: Chtonien
description: Prophète du Vide interprétant les signes avant-coureurs du réveil des Anciens pour préparer les défenses spirituelles.

subject.archetype: Chtonian Void Prophet - Colossal tectonic entity with obsidian-plated carapace fused to a semi-molten skeletal core, multiple pupilless eyes glowing with inner magma, born from deep earth fissures to interpret dimensional collapse signs

loadout.armor_outfit: Natural tectonic carapace composed of asymmetrical obsidian plates with basalt underlayers, cracks revealing molten magma veins pulsing with geothermal light, stone horns jutting from skull-like mineral protrusions, ash-grey volcanic smoke escaping from joints and fissures
loadout.arsenal: Integrated geothermal systems as weapons - magma conduits running through forearms terminating in drill-like appendages, seismic resonance abilities manifesting as ground-shaking pulses, runic symbols etched in magma on body surfaces

attitude.behavior: Crouched technician stance with massive clawed limbs actively welding and reinforcing dimensional barriers, sparks of molten energy flying from contact points with reality-fractures, body coiled with primordial tension, coiled springs of magma-filled muscle tissue ready to unleash seismic devastation
attitude.emotion: Cold primordial focus radiating supernatural dread, multiple eyes locked on approaching dimensional tears with fanatical interpretation of void patterns, ancient consciousness channeled through burning magma-filled veins

palette_names.name: Obsidian Black
palette_names.role: Primary structural element - carapace plates and shadow foundations

palette_names.name: Matte Basalt Grey
palette_names.role: Secondary mineral texture - tectonic underlayers and mineral deposits

palette_names.name: Scorched Earth Brown
palette_names.role: Organic rocky flesh tones - heat-weathered surfaces

palette_names.name: Magma Incandescence
palette_names.role: Light source accent - glowing veins, eye glow, energy emissions

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Mixed dramatic rim lighting from internal magma glow contrasting against dark dimensional void, volumetric ash fog, orange-red subsurface scattering from geothermal energy, supernatural eldritch light bleeding from reality tears
color_and_light.mood: Oppressive supernatural dread, primordial terror, catastrophic magnificence, apocalyptic menace

camera.angle: Low angle looking up at towering Chtonian form, dutch angle tilted to emphasize dimensional instability, slight tilt toward collapsed reality fractures

scenography.setting: Torn dimensional battlefield - ground ripped open in massive fissures exposing magma chambers below, reality collapsing at edges forming impossible geometry, ancient runic patterns burning on every surface, shadow tentacles erupting from abyssal depths, sky fracturing into wrong cosmic angles beyond human comprehension
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Thick oppressive volcanic smoke, reality thinning at edges with visual distortion, dimensional sparks and sparks from active welding work, gravitational anomalies warping space, ancient runes blazing with eldritch fire on all surfaces, ash and debris falling, ground constantly shifting from seismic activity
